Official repository: https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo
Official release: https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases/tag/v1.19.33
Exact source commit: 3f27ef39f8c96bbfbc8b0b9bb10f5c9ef60149d8
Corresponding source is included beside this notice as mihomo-source.tar.gz.
Upstream build instructions, release workflows, go.mod and go.sum are inside
that source archive. No Mihomo patches or modifications are applied.
The archive is the upstream tag source from:
https://codeload.github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.19.33
SHA-256: e7c596b37ff27ec487d19b1920f73e0c97a78067ea35766530ee9659ade72711

The bundled manifest records exact official asset and executable SHA-256s.
Mihomo is a separate process, with its own GPL license. ExitGuard's original
source remains under its existing MIT license. Neither executable enables a
system proxy, TUN or DNS listener; ExitGuard supplies only a selected leaf and
private authenticated loopback listener. Subscription URLs are never supplied
to the core. Source and binaries may be redistributed under their own licenses.

The matching official vendored dependency source is also included as
mihomo-vendor.tar.gz; extract its vendor/ directory beside the source go.mod.
URL: https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases/download/v1.19.33/vendor.tar.gz
SHA-256: 7ac4d4da0e6a29ef6ed18d2cf8f4c58d361d049ae364fd841acc883aa3a9e1cc

Upstream's build workflow uses its custom Go toolchain. The unchanged official
compiler artifact (not needed to run ExitGuard) is available at:
https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases/download/v1.19.33/toolchain.tar.gz
SHA-256: a827640a1ae37475583ed82eb762ed563d40a4eeb83461acfb5ee8ff10fe4a55
Toolchain source: https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/tree/release-branch.go1.26
See .github/workflows/build.yml in the included source for exact build flags,
platform matrix and upstream toolchain setup.

The separately linked GPL native URI importer uses this same pinned source
and vendor. Its corresponding wrapper source/license/build instructions are
included as mihomo-importer-source.tar.gz. importer-manifest.json records the
wrapper source digest and platform executable hashes. ExitGuard's main
application does not link the native conversion library.
